task: Generate one photorealistic still frame that looks like a paused vertical video a real man recorded of himself with his iPhone front camera, in his office, to talk to his audience. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it must be indistinguishable from a real phone recording.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

subject.identity: an original, non-famous Ecuadorian man (Latin American mestizo), 36 years old
subject.face: warm light-brown skin with natural texture (visible pores, slight unevenness, faint under-eye lines), dark brown eyes, defined but friendly features, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: short black hair, neat low fade on the sides, slightly textured on top, naturally styled, a few loose strands
subject.facial_hair: short, well-groomed black beard, closely trimmed, natural edges
subject.accessories: no glasses, simple steel wristwatch on the left wrist, no other jewelry

wardrobe.top: dark olive green casual button-up shirt in soft cotton, top button undone, sleeves rolled up to the forearms, natural fabric wrinkles
wardrobe.style: smart casual entrepreneur, relaxed and approachable, nothing flashy, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: seated at his desk, upper body leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural half-smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted, relaxed jaw
pose_and_expression.hands: both hands resting naturally on the desk in the lower part of the frame, fingers relaxed and loosely interlaced, all fingers anatomically correct and fully visible
pose_and_expression.posture: shoulders relaxed and square to the camera, natural and unposed

environment.location: his own small, modern, bright office during the day
environment.background: clean white walls, white suspended ceiling panels visible at the top, a light grey office chair behind him, a low white cabinet against the back wall with a small potted green plant on it, uncluttered; no window visible at his sides
environment.foreground: the corner of an open silver laptop at the bottom right edge of the frame, slightly out of focus, on a light grey desk
environment.atmosphere: tidy, real, lived-in workspace, not a staged studio set

camera.device: iPhone front camera propped on the desk at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; his head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean empty wall and ceiling above his head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused frontal daylight from a large window directly in front of him, behind the phone, lighting his whole face evenly from the front
lighting.fill: neutral white overhead office ceiling panels that brighten the room evenly
lighting.mood: bright, clean and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit with the same brightness and no side shadows, only very soft natural shading under the chin and nose; accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: must look like a real person recorded on a phone, not AI-generated and not a stock photo
real skin texture, no smoothing, no beauty filter, no plastic or waxy skin
natural fabric folds and wrinkles on the shirt
correct human anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions
realistic eyes with natural catchlights from the window in front of him
even, symmetrical illumination on the face, as when someone films himself facing a window
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements
side lighting, split lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, strong shadows on one side of the face, a window beside him lighting the face from the side
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, asymmetrical eyes, warped face
smooth or airbrushed skin, 3D render, cartoon, illustration, CGI look
suit and tie, formal wear, flashy clothes, visible brand logos
a likeness of any real or famous person
